Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Style: Korean MMORPG 3D key art — a semi-realistic 3D beauty with a small refined face and delicate realistic-anime features, porcelain skin with a soft glow, extremely ornate engraved armour and jewellery with glossy highlights, a strong rim light and drifting light particles, a luxurious promotional finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Outfit: a music-festival outfit — a crochet crop top with a delicate body chain, frayed denim micro shorts and ankle boots, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a close-up of her face and hair; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; head tilted slightly; camera at her eye level.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right fingertips rest lightly on her cheek.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand stays outside the frame.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: softly lidded eyes, lips relaxed.

Framing: a close-up — her face and hair fill most of the frame and the bottom edge crosses at her collarbones; nothing below the shoulders shows, and her hands and anything she holds stay below the frame unless raised to her face.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most the one small accessory below.

Her legend — brilliant ruthless ambition, a poet singing over wine before battle, the Bronze Sparrow Terrace, a magnetic and dangerous charm, suspicion and genius, black-and-navy war banners — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Accessory: off duty she carries no weapon or armour — her signature weapon (the Sky-Leaning Sword, an ornate long jian) appears only as a belt charm modelled on its shape and colours, a few centimetres long, clearly jewellery.

Light: the place's own light, with a strong soft rim light tracing her hair and shoulders, glossy highlights on skin and jewellery and drifting light particles — a luxurious promotional glow.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
